items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: But I did quite a lot with Joe, see, particularly weekends, you know, see.

ctx.x: He could play a little trombone in a Elks' bands, and he had about 2, 3 bands of that type up there, big military bands. Then he would tell people, and they, and the word would get around, see. And I think, I think - I think the first, this is the first band that Joe Steele - I think it was Joe Steele the pianist who graduated from the New England Conservatory. And that was dance also, booked for dancing, you see.
